name: ComplaintCase
description: A customer complaint record capturing the full lifecycle from receipt to closure. Owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core). The canonical record for all DISP regulatory reporting obligations.

fields.name: complaint_id
fields.description: Primary key — globally unique complaint identifier

fields.name: complaint_reference
fields.description: Human-readable reference: COMP-YYYYMMDD-NNNN. Issued to customer at receipt.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: FK → Customer (ENT-001)

fields.name: affected_account_id
fields.description: FK → Account record of the affected product

fields.name: affected_product_type
fields.description: Product category the complaint relates to

fields.name: complaint_type
fields.description: Nature of the complaint

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Brief complaint subject line

fields.name: description
fields.description: Full complaint description provided by customer

fields.name: desired_outcome
fields.description: Customer's stated desired resolution

fields.name: channel_received
fields.description: Channel through which complaint was submitted

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current lifecycle status

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Assigned at triage

fields.name: assigned_to
fields.description: FK → internal staff member (PER-062) or escalation queue ID

fields.name: category
fields.description: Detailed categorisation code used for DISP reporting (e.g. 'general_insurance_protection', 'payment_account')

fields.name: target_resolution_date
fields.description: Target date for resolution — set at triage. 3 business days for simple, 8 weeks maximum.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Resolution decision — set at PH-100

fields.name: redress_amount
fields.description: Financial redress amount in GBP if applicable. Zero for non-financial remedies.

fields.name: redress_payment_id
fields.description: FK → payment instruction for redress if applicable

fields.name: investigation_notes
fields.description: Internal investigation notes — not visible to customer

fields.name: root_cause_analysis
fields.description: Root cause analysis for systemic complaints — required for Consumer Duty obligations

fields.name: regulated_flag
fields.description: True if complaint involves a regulated product or conduct concern requiring compliance oversight

fields.name: fos_referred
fields.description: True if customer has referred to FOS

fields.name: fos_case_reference
fields.description: FOS case reference number if fos_referred = true

fields.name: response_type
fields.description: Type of regulatory response issued — determined by elapsed time

fields.name: response_sent_at
fields.description: Timestamp when resolution communication was dispatched to customer

fields.name: received_at
fields.description: Timestamp when complaint was received

fields.name: triaged_at
fields.description: Timestamp when triage was completed

fields.name: resolved_at
fields.description: Timestamp when resolution decision was made

fields.name: closed_at
fields.description: Timestamp when complaint was closed

relationships.description: Many ComplaintCases may exist for one Customer
Many ComplaintCases may relate to one DisCaseSummary (DISP aggregation)

design_decisions.decision: ComplaintCase is owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core) rather than a dedicated complaint management service.
design_decisions.rationale: At current complaint volumes, a dedicated service adds operational complexity without benefit. SVC-001 already holds the customer relationship data needed for investigation. This can be promoted to a separate service if complaint volumes or regulatory complexity justify it.
design_decisions.rejected_because: Over-engineering for current scale. Promotion criteria: if complaint handling requires distinct staff tooling, separate data lifecycle, or crosses multiple capabilities with equal ownership.
